title: A Signal for the Gravity
author: Silas Kavanagh
blurb: Jonah Okonkwo, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
